faq.q: Which Chilliwack areas appear on this page?
faq.a: The page's own cards shown in this pass were labelled Chilliwack Mountain, East Chilliwack, Fairfield Island, Little Mountain and Eastern Hillsides, and the page's editorial framing also groups Ryder Lake, Majuba Hill, Columbia Valley, Promontory, Cultus Lake, Greendale, Yarrow and Rosedale — feed and framing labels only, not a price claim about any sub-area.

faq.q: What plan and permit areas matter for a hillside or farm property in this band?
faq.a: The City's 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw 2025, No. 5500) governs, including its Schedule B neighbourhood plans and Schedule D development permit areas — D-2 Hillside Environment, D-5 Hillside Development and D-4 Farm Home Plate among them; which areas apply is a per-parcel check with the City.
